projects.title: Yarden Jewelry
projects.subtitle: Redefining the Visual Direction of an E-commerce Brand
projects.scope: Visual Direction, Color System, Logo Design, Image Art Direction, Design-to-Development Collaboration
projects.deliverable: Refined visual direction for a live e-commerce store
projects.summary: When an already-developed e-commerce store failed to meet the client's visual expectations, I stepped in to establish a clearer brand direction—from exploring color palettes and developing a new logo concept to collaborating with development on implementation.
projects.myContribution: Spoke directly with the client in a WhatsApp group to understand his concerns, developed and presented four alternative color palette directions, created an approved logo concept, prepared and adapted website imagery, and collaborated with a developer on implementation.
projects.teamContribution: Developers built the original e-commerce store prior to my involvement and collaborated on implementing the approved visual direction and logo.
projects.verifiedOutcome: Client selected option four of the proposed color directions, approved the new logo concept, launched the live website, and paid an additional $100 for the color-direction/logo work and implementation.

projects.title: Beresheet Dead Sea
projects.subtitle: E-commerce Product Design
projects.scope: E-commerce UX · Conversion-Focused Design · Content Design
projects.teamContext: Product Manager + Product Designer + Frontend Developer
projects.summary: Improved product-page experiences with a conversion-focused approach, designing interactive before-and-after comparisons, product-specific skincare content, and customer video sections to help shoppers understand product benefits and make more informed purchase decisions.
projects.myContribution: Researched products with the client, developed product-specific UX copy, designed the product-benefit and comparison sections, and collaborated with developers to bring these improvements to life.
projects.teamContribution: E-commerce platform integration, payment processing, product photography, and promotional Meta Ads campaigns handled by the broader team and client.
projects.earlyOutcome: 2 orders in the first week of promotional campaigns following the product-page improvements.
